description: Small deterministic starter set for engineering regressions. It is not a production accuracy claim and is not a substitute for the planned human-labelled holdout set.
split_rule: Every case carries split=dev or split=holdout. Tune rules and models only on dev; holdout cases measure final behaviour. Metrics are reported per split in split_metrics.

planned_scale.missing_samples_reason: 第一版僅交付覆蓋每個量測面向的合成種子集；議題建議的完整規模留待人工標註，不以重複或模型產生的樣本湊數。

determinism.note: The evaluator performs no random sampling; identical manifest, cases and predictions produce byte-identical report JSON (sorted keys).

regression_gate.rule: A failed regression gate cannot be bypassed by claiming the new model is better overall; every regressed metric and case is listed in baseline_comparison.
